status_values.migrated: Axum route exists and uses PostgreSQL/read_model/job/object storage facts.
status_values.migrated_shadow_required: Axum route exists, but Python vs Axum staging shadow validation must be GO before traffic cutover.
status_values.partial: Some methods in the domain are migrated; remaining methods stay on Python.
status_values.pending_contract: Python/frontend contract is known, but Axum route is intentionally not implemented in this prompt.
status_values.blocked_fact_source: Do not migrate until PostgreSQL/read_model/job/object-storage fact source is specified.

blocked_routes.POST /api/background-jobs/{job_id}/ackno: 旧 Python 写入 acknowledged 状态和 acknowledged_at；当前 job.worker_tasks 状态机没有 acknowledged，需先冻结通知/ack 状态模型。

routes.source: Session/search/task status/app metadata routes use Axum PostgreSQL/read-model/contracts where implemented. App-health JSON snapshot and SSE stream read PostgreSQL app.oa_sync_runs/app.oa_sync_watermarks, job.worker_tasks, and read_model.workbench_snapshots; neither route reads app Mongo alerts/dirty scope state. Background-job active list reads PostgreSQL job.worker_tasks system tasks and returns the legacy Python list envelope. Background-job retry creates PostgreSQL worker task/outbox/audit/idempotency records and does not execute side effects in the request path.

blocked_routes.PATCH /api/bank-details/transactions/cat: 分类写入需要 actor、audit、read-model invalidation 和 job/outbox 合同；本批只迁移 bank transaction facts 读取。

routes.source: GET routes use PostgreSQL app.bank_transactions + app.bank_transaction_categories. Auto category and relation tag enrichment remain expected shadow diffs because no dedicated PostgreSQL/read_model source is frozen. PATCH requires audit/job/outbox and was not migrated.
GET routes use PostgreSQL app.no_oa_bank_batches + app.bank_transactions; POST routes already existed in Axum workbench_writes and require existing dry-run/shadow validation before cutover.

blocked_routes.GET /api/turnover-ledger/export: 二进制 XLSX 导出需冻结 workbook 样式、Content-Disposition、全量分页和 extra/FIFO 字段；当前只迁移 JSON export-preview。
blocked_routes.GET /api/turnover-ledger/relations/{rela: 旧值来自 turnover extra snapshot/app state；无 PostgreSQL/read_model 事实源前不能只返回默认 extra 遮蔽差异。
blocked_routes.PUT /api/turnover-ledger/relations/{rela: extra 写入来自旧 extra snapshot，并需 actor/audit/read-model invalidation 合同。
blocked_routes.POST /api/turnover-ledger/relations/conf: 人工确认写入 relation state，需冻结 PostgreSQL relation facts、audit、幂等和 outbox 合同。
blocked_routes.POST /api/turnover-ledger/relations/{rel: 撤回写入 relation state，需冻结 PostgreSQL relation facts、audit、幂等和 outbox 合同。

routes.source: GET /api/turnover-ledger flat/grouped read-only views, GET /api/turnover-ledger/export-preview, and GET /api/turnover-ledger/relations/{relation_id} derive from PostgreSQL app.bank_transactions plus active app.bank_transaction_categories raw_payload.category_code using Python turnover category/export/detail rules; no app Mongo. Binary export, relation extra GET/PUT, confirm/withdraw, persisted manual relation state, and FIFO allocation lots remain pending contract.

blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/import/preview: ETC import preview parses uploaded files and creates legacy preview state; needs object-storage/job contract before Axum migration.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/import/confirm: ETC import confirm persists parsed invoices and invalidates downstream state; needs audit/job/outbox and object-storage contract.
blocked_routes.GET /api/etc/reconciliation-tasks/ready-: ETC reconciliation task state loads from legacy state store/local pickle; no independent PostgreSQL/read_model source is frozen.
blocked_routes.GET /api/etc/reconciliation-tasks: ETC reconciliation task list loads from legacy state store/local pickle; no independent PostgreSQL/read_model source is frozen.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/reconciliation-tasks: ETC reconciliation task creation writes legacy task/file state; needs job/object-storage/audit contract.
blocked_routes.GET|DELETE /api/etc/reconciliation-tasks: Task detail/delete reads or mutates legacy reconciliation task state; no independent PostgreSQL/read_model source and audit contract are frozen.
blocked_routes.GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/etc/reconciliation: Task detail, attachment and status operations read/write legacy reconciliation task state and files.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/batches/draft: OA draft creation writes external/OA draft state; needs OA/job/outbox and audit contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/batches/{batch_id}/draft: OA draft creation for an existing batch writes external/OA draft state; needs OA/job/outbox and audit contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/batches/{batch_id}/confirm: Submitted-state mutation is a batch write path requiring actor, audit and fact-state transition contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/batches/{batch_id}/mark-no: Submitted-state rollback is a batch write path requiring actor, audit and fact-state transition contract.
blocked_routes.DELETE /api/etc/batches/{batch_id}: Batch deletion/cancellation is a write path requiring actor, audit and fact-state transition contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/etc/invoices/revoke-submitted: Invoice submitted-state revoke mutates invoice facts and must be covered by audit/outbox/read-model invalidation.

routes.source: POST /api/etc/import is a static legacy removal contract returning 410. GET /api/etc/invoices and read-only batch list/detail read PostgreSQL app.invoices ETC columns/raw_payload only; batch summaries group import_batch_id/current_batch_id facts and do not read app Mongo. Import preview/confirm, reconciliation, OA draft write routes remain blocked on job/outbox/object-storage contracts.

blocked_routes.POST /api/tax-offset/certified-import/pr: Python parses multipart Excel files and persists tax_certified_import_sessions in legacy app state; needs PostgreSQL/object-storage preview-session contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/tax-offset/certified-import/co: Python confirms a legacy preview session, writes certification records and invalidates read models; needs audit/outbox/idempotency contract.

routes.source: Month GET and calculate use PostgreSQL read_model.tax_offset_read_models. Certified import list uses PostgreSQL app.invoice_certifications joined to app.invoices. Certified import preview/confirm remain on Python until write/audit/outbox contract is frozen.

blocked_routes.GET /api/cost-statistics/export: Binary XLSX export needs workbook style, detail inclusion flags, Content-Disposition and large-result behavior frozen separately; JSON export-preview is migrated.

routes.source: Main/explorer/project detail/export-preview reads use PostgreSQL read_model.cost_statistics_read_models. Transaction detail additionally uses app.bank_transactions to locate scope month and read_model.workbench_rows for summary/detail fields. Binary Excel export remains pending until exact workbook contract is frozen.

blocked_routes.POST /api/workbench/settings: Settings save mutates app settings and access-control state; needs PostgreSQL settings facts, audit and rollback contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/workbench/settings/projects/sy: Project sync talks to OA/project sources and mutates settings projections; needs source contract and job/outbox boundary.
blocked_routes.POST /api/workbench/settings/projects: Project create/update is an admin write path requiring PostgreSQL settings facts, audit and rollback contract.
blocked_routes.DELETE /api/workbench/settings/projects/: Project deletion is an admin write path requiring PostgreSQL settings facts, audit and rollback contract.
blocked_routes.POST /api/workbench/settings/data-reset/: Data reset job creation schedules destructive admin work; needs job/outbox, permissions, backup and rollback evidence.
blocked_routes.POST /api/workbench/settings/data-reset: Data reset execution is destructive admin work; needs backup, audit, idempotency and rollback contract.

routes.source: Settings read route is default projection only. Data-reset job status reads use PostgreSQL job.worker_tasks. Sync, mutations, job creation, and reset execution require PostgreSQL settings facts plus admin audit/job/outbox contract and were not migrated.

blocked_routes.POST /api/workbench/exception/preview: Exception preview depends on legacy Python exception projection and matching candidate state; no independent PostgreSQL/read_model preview contract is frozen.

routes.source: Workbench read routes use read_model.workbench_snapshots and read_model.workbench_rows. Workbench action routes already exposed by Axum build transactional PostgreSQL workbench write commands with actor, expected_version and idempotency_key, then rely on job/outbox/read-model invalidation; they must be shadowed only against isolated local/staging fixture data. Exception preview remains Python-only until its read_model preview contract is frozen.

blocked_routes.GET|POST /projects: Legacy project routes remain Python state/source driven; PostgreSQL project facts and mutation contract are not frozen.
blocked_routes.GET /projects/{project_id}: Legacy project detail route lacks frozen PostgreSQL fact/source contract.
blocked_routes.POST /projects/assign: Project assignment is a write path requiring actor, audit and fact-state transition contract.
blocked_routes.GET /ledgers: Legacy ledger list lacks frozen PostgreSQL fact/read-model contract.
blocked_routes.GET /ledgers/{ledger_id}: Legacy ledger detail lacks frozen PostgreSQL fact/read-model contract.
blocked_routes.POST /ledgers/{ledger_id}/status: Ledger status mutation needs actor, audit and fact-state transition contract.
blocked_routes.GET /reminders: Legacy reminders lack frozen job/read-model fact contract.
blocked_routes.POST /reminders/run: Reminder execution is a job-producing write path requiring job/outbox contract.
blocked_routes.POST /imports/preview: Legacy import preview parses files into Python session state; use migrated metadata/preflight routes until object-storage/job contract is frozen.
blocked_routes.POST /imports/confirm: Legacy import confirm writes business facts and invalidates read models; needs audit/outbox/idempotency contract.
blocked_routes.POST /imports/files/preview: File preview creates legacy file session state; needs object-storage/session fact contract.
blocked_routes.POST /imports/files/confirm: File confirm writes business facts from legacy session state; needs audit/outbox/idempotency contract.
blocked_routes.GET /imports/batches/{batch_id}/download: Batch download is binary/object response behavior requiring object-storage and Content-Disposition contract.
blocked_routes.POST /imports/batches/{batch_id}/revert: Batch revert mutates imported facts and read models; needs audit/outbox/idempotency and rollback contract.

routes.source: Import metadata and file-object routes use PostgreSQL app.import_batches/import_files/file_objects plus object-storage access provider for bounded presigned access metadata. Import file retry and matching run create PostgreSQL worker task/outbox/audit/idempotency records without request-path side effects. Import session projection maps app.import_batches legacy_session_id to batch/file metadata. Matching results read read_model.workbench_candidate_matches. Legacy project, ledger, reminder, import confirm/revert routes remain blocked pending facts/job/outbox contracts.
